prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a premium activewear landing page featuring an adult female model in a sleek gym set mid-motion, the approved brand name PixPretty Active, a clean light gray background, floating product cards for leggings, tops and shoes, performance-focused UI sections, bold typography MOVE, dynamic lighting and a modern sporty aesthetic. Include a clear navigation bar, product cards with approved names and prices, coral call-to-action buttons, feature icons, and a bottom performance summary bar. Keep the layout clean, accessible and commercial, with realistic activewear fabric, natural skin texture, sharp typography and a 1:1 square composition.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, illegible UI text, inconsistent product cards, distorted icons, duplicated limbs
